fact: The UNDP Digital Readiness Assessment names the Plan Stratégique Numérique 2023-2028, aligned with the Politique Générale de l'État and the SDGs, as Madagascar's national digital vision; no as-of date is given, so the report's December 2025 publication date is used.

UNDP states the Plan Stratégique Numérique 2023-2028 sets targets including raising the digital sector's contribution to GDP to 6% by 2028; no cost is stated (date: report publication, December 2025).

UNDP states the plan is placed under the coordination of the digital ministry (MNDPT), which ensures coherence and strategic supervision of digital transformation; only 21% of surveyed experts consider the ministry and the Unité de Gouvernance Digitale fully operational (report December 2025).
UNDP reports that 86% of surveyed experts say digital budgets are limited per project and without sustained financing; it ties no budget line to the plan (report December 2025).

Ecofin says the technical and vocational education strategy aligns with the Strategic Digital Plan (PSN 2023-2028), launched by the Ministry of Digital Development, Digital Transformation, Posts and Telecommunications; no act of adoption and no launch date is stated, so the article's 23 September 2025 publication date is used.

The US Commercial Service guide says the government's Digital Transformation Plan 2023-2028 (Plan Stratégique Numérique) aims to raise the digital sector's contribution to GDP by six percent by 2028; no cost is stated (guide published 4 August 2025).

We Are Tech Africa reports that the Digital Readiness Assessment launched by the digital ministry and UNDP on 27 February 2025 in Antsirabe serves as the basis for a strategic roadmap; no roadmap text, scope or adoption is stated.
